name: Tejas Singh live: acoustic singer and guitarist for private parties and weddings
seoTitle: Tejas Singh live: acoustic singer and guitarist
description: This is Tejas Singh's full live set at Sofar Sounds, singing and playing guitar. He can bring the same sound to your private party or wedding cocktail hour.
more: Before he moved to Denver, Tejas played more than 200 shows a year in Washington, D.C. and New York City. At events he mostly plays covers, and they reach right up to the songs of the last twenty years. He plays in Denver, along the Front Range and in the Colorado mountains.
